name: Natasha Minnie
role: The creative mind behind Digital Mom
quote: A business that stops advertising to save money is like someone who stops the clock to save time.
alt: Natasha smiling, sitting on a white backdrop in a black top and jeans with one hand in her hair.
bio: Hi, I’m Natasha Minnie, the creative mind behind Digital Mom.

I didn’t start out wanting to be a “marketing expert.” I simply followed my passion for design, creativity, connection, and solving real-world problems. Along the way, I discovered the magic of digital marketing and how powerful it can be when done with heart.

Today, I help businesses transform quiet online spaces into vibrant, engaged communities. Whether it’s through strategy, content creation, or visual design, I love building brands that look good, sound real, and actually connect with people.
Let me help you do just that, by managing your social media and giving you the space to focus on what you do best: growing your business.

name: Charlene
quote: If your brand doesn’t speak, someone else’s will. Make sure yours says something worth hearing.
alt: Charlene smiling, sitting on a white backdrop in a patterned dark top and jeans with a hand on her head.
bio: Hi, I’m Charlene, the client-focused creative and strategy-driven soul at Digital Mom.

My passion lies in building strong, meaningful relationships and helping brands grow with purpose. I thrive in the space where connection meets creativity, whether I’m pitching fresh ideas, managing client relationships, or designing content that tells a story.
Sales may be my strength, but it’s the trust and collaboration I build along the way that truly matter.
I’m here to make sure every client feels heard, supported, and excited about what’s next.

name: Danika
role: The creative force behind the planning, ideas and words
quote: If your audience isn’t listening, it’s not their fault. It’s yours.
alt: Danika smiling, sitting on a white backdrop in a black top and jeans with her head resting on one hand.
bio: Hi, I’m Danika, the creative force behind the planning, ideas, and words at Digital Mom.

I’m passionate about turning messy thoughts into meaningful strategies, and I believe that good content starts with clear intention. Whether I’m researching trends, writing copy, or capturing on-brand photography, my goal is always the same: to help brands speak clearly and connect deeply.
It’s not about chasing trends, it’s about creating content that reflects the heart of a brand and resonates with the people it’s meant for.
I’m here to help you communicate with clarity, show up with confidence, and create content that actually works.

name: Chanel
role: Too busy with your story to finish hers.
quote: I’ll send my bio as soon as I’ve finished this one last thing for a client…
alt: Chanel smiling, sitting on a white backdrop in a green top with her chin resting on her hand.
bio: We asked Chanel for a bio. She asked if she could finish a client project first. We haven’t heard back about the bio.
Her proper introduction is coming soon. We’ve added ourselves to her client list.
